item.name: AI-Ready Data
item.verbatim_text: Al-Ready Data: Data that is discoverable, machine-readable and machine-understandable, and has sufficient quality, documentation, and access methods to support the full AI application development and use life cycle.
item.grounding_span: Al-Ready Data: Data that is discoverable, machine-readable and machine-understandable, and has sufficient quality, documentation, and access methods to support the full AI application development and use life cycle.

provenance.rationale: §3.01 is the definition the L0 crosswalk measures this instrument against; §4.05 and §5.02.d are its operative directives.

item.name: NAO 216-128 §4.05
item.claim_text: NOAA shall undertake efforts to define, develop, and make publicly available data that is Al-ready to support efficient and trustworthy AI use.
item.grounding_span: NOAA shall undertake efforts to define, develop, and make publicly available data that is Al-ready to support efficient and trustworthy AI use.

provenance.rationale: §3.01 is the definition the L0 crosswalk measures this instrument against; §4.05 and §5.02.d are its operative directives.

item.name: NAO 216-128 §5.02.d
item.claim_text: Establish data and metadata standards for Al-ready data in accordance with applicable NOAA policies and industry best practices;
item.grounding_span: Establish data and metadata standards for Al-ready data in accordance with applicable NOAA policies and industry best practices;
